params.1273: Sir Vant will need to return the squire's weapons and armour to the family. Take them off and give them to him.
params.1292: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.
params.1274: Take off your armour and weapons by opening the worn equipment tab and clicking on them.
params.1275: Right-click on the items in your inventory and choose Use, then click on Sir Vant to hand back the kit.
